content: pkoukk/tiktoken-go is the common Go port of OpenAI tiktoken (o200k_base/cl100k_base). Exact counts matter for OpenAI API hard limits; chars/4 is rough English only. For paste-into-Claude/ChatGPT offline Markdown, model-agnostic byte/rune budgets + smart truncation beat adding tiktoken (OpenAI-biased, embedding tables, wrong for Claude). Defer tiktoken-go unless shipping OpenAI API calls.
